{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Casting or Channeling a {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skill grants a stack of Momentum, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c}. Casting a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill removes a stack of Momentum.

For each stack of Momentum, you gain:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|2%|]{/c} Maximum Energy
{icon:bullet,1.2} {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1|2x%|]{/c} Energy Regeneration
{icon:bullet,1.2} {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[Affix_Value_1*Affix."Static Value 2"|2x%|]{/c} Increased Damage{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
